thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: sev=5 high error rate on /v1/embedder -> elevated 5xxs and latency for Hosted API in us-west1. Paging on-call: @sara-oncall :rotating_light:

sara-oncall: Got it. Joining incident channel. Initial check: UI shows spikes, customers complaining about embed requests timing out.

priya-sre: I'm on infra triage, pulling `kubectl -n embed logs` now. Noting many OOMKilled on embedder pods and TTL evictions on local cache.

josh-eng: Seen similar in perf tests last week with kv-cache TTL misconfig on new rollout. Which image tag rolled?

priya-sre: Rollout id `embed-deploy-2024-02-03-22` at 22:03 UTC. I can revert if needed.

mateo-triage: Customer-impact: top 3 customers in prod experiencing 20-30% error rates on embedding endpoints. Support is getting escalations. @anjali-support please confirm.

anjali-support: Confirmed. Two enterprise customers hit SLA alerts; we've opened support tickets and informed both that we're mitigating.

emily-pm: Copy. We need incident severity notes for postmortem later. Please capture timeline and customer impact for exec summary.

priya-sre: Quick mitigation: scaling down new replica set and scaling up previous stable RS. Command: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/embedder --to-revision=7` executed. Monitoring.

josh-eng: Nice. Also disabling local TTL eviction loop for now: set `EMBED_CACHE_TTL_DISABLE=true` in staging env and will push to prod if rollback insufficient.

sara-oncall: Rollback started at 22:18 UTC. Error rate trending down but still elevated. Continuing to monitor.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged by @sara-oncall. Incident channel created: #incident-1706428390.

priya-sre: Post-rollback: embed pods stable, memory usage lower, error rate dropped to <2% for most regions except us-west1 heavy tail.

tom-englead: Good containment. Next steps: schedule postmortem, create action items for root cause and remediation. Prioritize by severity (sev5 → P0 actions for Q next sprint).

emily-pm: Proposed postmortem time: tomorrow 16:00 PT. Who can own writeup?

josh-eng: I can draft the technical root-cause section. Will need logs and deploy diffs from priya.

priya-sre: I'll export deploy history, pod logs, and metrics. Assigning myself to link artifacts.

anjali-support: I'll prepare customer-impact timeline and list of affected accounts for the PM and SREs.

mateo-triage: Let's create action items in the remediation board now. Quick list and t-shirt sizing:
- Action A: Fix embed TTL config to avoid aggressive eviction (owner: josh-eng) — size: S (1-2 days)
- Action B: Add guardrail for new deploys that monitors OOM rate and auto-rolls back (owner: priya-sre) — size: L (2-3 sprints)
- Action C: Create runbook for embedder OOM mitigation and rollback steps (owner: sara-oncall) — size: M (3-5 days)
- Action D: Customer communication template and SLA remediation notes (owner: anjali-support) — size: XS (1 day)

emily-pm: Mapping to priorities: Action B is P0 for reliability roadmap this quarter, Action A is P1 but must be done before next deploy, C is P1, D is P2 for legal/comms alignment.

tom-englead: Agree. For sprint planning, move Action B into next sprint (capacity permitting) and schedule Action A as an immediate patch.

sara-oncall: I've created quick tasks and added owners in the incident thread: `/incident task add "patch embed ttl" owner:josh-eng due:2024-02-06 size:S`

incident-bot: Task created: #task-9872 "patch embed ttl" assigned to josh-eng due 2024-02-06.

josh-eng: Taking #task-9872. Will PR with config change + unit tests today, request review from tom-englead.

priya-sre: For Action B (auto-rollback), I'll put together design doc and estimate 8-12 dev days; will break down to spikes: metrics alerting (2d), rollout controller change (4-6d), e2e tests (2-4d).

emily-pm: Good. Add risk assessment to doc — impact if delayed = repeated customer SLA hits. We'll present prioritization at weekly roadmap sync.

anjali-support: I've drafted the customer message for affected accounts and pro-rated credits for SLA breaches. Ready for PM review.

mateo-triage: Postmortem scheduled 2024-02-06 16:00 PT. Agenda: timeline, root cause, mitigations applied, action items + owners + sizing, release gating to prevent repeat.

tom-englead: Please ensure action items include measurable acceptance criteria and owner-defined deadlines. I'll block time for code review on josh's PR.

sara-oncall: Final status: incident contained, services healthy except brief tail. I'll hand off monitoring to priya for 12h watch.

priya-sre: Acknowledged. I'll consolidate logs and artifacts into the postmortem doc link: (will post link in the doc before meeting).

emily-pm: Thanks team. After postmortem, we'll map actions into quarterly plan: Action B → Q1 reliability epic, Action A/C → next sprint tasks, D → support backlog.

anjali-support: 👍 I'll update customers with final note after the postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident resolved by @sara-oncall at 22:48 UTC. Marking as resolved with severity=5.

sara-oncall: Closing thread. See you in the postmortem. :white_check_mark:
